title: Container Bookings: Time Limit for Asking Goodwill on a Roll Fee
content:
A Container Bookings customer who wants goodwill on a customer roll fee must ask for it within a set number of days after that fee was entered.

## Rule

The request qualifies only if the number of calendar days from the entry date of the customer roll fee entry addressed to the day of the request does not exceed the product's goodwill request period. Days are counted on calendar dates alone, without regard to the time of day. A request made on the final day of the period is still in time.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical period of 45 days)

| Fee entered | Request made | Days elapsed | In time? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 1 March | 0 | yes |
| 1 March | 15 April | 45 | yes |
| 1 March | 16 April | 46 | no |

## Points of judgement

- **Which date starts the count?** The entry date of the fee entry the goodwill addresses.
- **Does the hour of the request matter?** No; only calendar dates are compared.

The period and dates used here are illustrative.
